title: 2025 年 12 月英语六级真题（第 1 套）

analysis.topic: 尊老美德的传承与社会意义
analysis.reference: Respecting the elderly is a traditional virtue of the Chinese nation, deeply rooted in the thoughts and behaviors of the Chinese people, and serves as a widely observed code of conduct and social norm. In today's China, this virtue has been extensively passed down. All sectors of society actively foster a social atmosphere of respecting and assisting the elderly. Providing convenient services for senior citizens has become a social consensus. For example, communities have set up canteens specifically for the elderly, and priority seats have been installed in public places. The government has also introduced a series of policies to provide strong safeguards for the rights and interests of the elderly. Respecting the elderly is an important cornerstone of social harmony and development, which helps cultivate a positive social atmosphere and promote the civilized progress of society as a whole.

sentences.cn: 尊老是中华民族的传统美德，深深植根于中国人的思想和行为中，是人们普遍遵守的行为规范和社会准则。
sentences.en: Respecting the elderly is a traditional virtue of the Chinese nation, deeply rooted in the thoughts and behaviors of the Chinese people, and serves as a widely observed code of conduct and social norm.
sentences.structure: 并列谓语结构（is... rooted... and serves as），主语 Respecting the elderly 后跟三个并列成分，过去分词短语 deeply rooted 作补充说明
keys: 传统美德 a traditional virtue
深深植根于 deeply rooted in
行为规范 code of conduct
社会准则 social norm
普遍遵守 widely observed

sentences.cn: 在当今的中国，这种美德得到广泛传承。
sentences.en: In today's China, this virtue has been extensively passed down.
sentences.structure: 简单句，介词短语 In today's China 作状语前置，主语 this virtue 搭配被动语态 has been passed down
keys: 当今的中国 today's China
广泛传承 extensively passed down

sentences.cn: 社会各界积极营造敬老助老的社会氛围。
sentences.en: All sectors of society actively foster a social atmosphere of respecting and assisting the elderly.
sentences.structure: 简单句，主语 All sectors of society 搭配动词 foster，of 介词短语作后置定语修饰 atmosphere
keys: 社会各界 all sectors of society
营造…氛围 foster an atmosphere
敬老助老 respecting and assisting the elderly

sentences.cn: 为老年人提供便利服务已成为社会共识，例如社区专门开设长者食堂，公共场所配置优先座位。
sentences.en: Providing convenient services for senior citizens has become a social consensus. For example, communities have set up canteens specifically for the elderly, and priority seats have been installed in public places.
sentences.structure: 动名词短语 Providing... 作主语，for example 引出两个并列举例分句，第二个分句用被动语态
keys: 社会共识 social consensus
便利服务 convenient services
长者食堂 canteens for the elderly
优先座位 priority seats
公共场所 public places

sentences.cn: 政府还出台了一系列政策，为老年人的权益提供有力保障。
sentences.en: The government has also introduced a series of policies to provide strong safeguards for the rights and interests of the elderly.
sentences.structure: 简单句，不定式短语 to provide... 作目的状语，介词短语 for the rights and interests 作宾语补足成分
keys: 出台政策 introduce policies
一系列 a series of
权益 rights and interests
有力保障 strong safeguards

sentences.cn: 尊老是社会和谐与发展的重要基石，有助于培育良好的社会氛围，推动整个社会文明进步。
sentences.en: Respecting the elderly is an important cornerstone of social harmony and development, which helps cultivate a positive social atmosphere and promote the civilized progress of society as a whole.
sentences.structure: 主句 + which 引导非限制性定语从句，从句内 helps 后接两个并列不定式 cultivate... and promote...
keys: 重要基石 an important cornerstone
社会和谐与发展 social harmony and development
培育良好的社会氛围 cultivate a positive social atmosphere
文明进步 civilized progress
整个社会 society as a whole

keys.en: a traditional virtue of the Chinese nation

pitfalls: 「深深植根于」误用 planted 代替 rooted，plant 强调动作而 root 强调状态
「社会各界」漏译或误译为 society people，应译为 all sectors of society
「长者食堂」直译为 old people restaurant，应译为 canteens for the elderly 更得体
「出台政策」误用 put out policies，应使用 introduce / implement / roll out policies
「基石」误译为 base/foundation 丢失语体层次，cornerstone 更正式贴切

upgrades.note: rooted in 是固定搭配，表示根深蒂固，比 planted 更地道自然

upgrades.better: a widely observed code of conduct
upgrades.note: 用 observed 搭配 code of conduct 更书面正式，符合社会规范语境
introduce policies 是政策语境中的标准搭配，比 make 更精准

upgrades.better: is an important cornerstone of social harmony
upgrades.note: cornerstone 隐喻更有力，比 good for 表达层次更高

upgrades.plain: help make a good social environment
upgrades.better: help cultivate a positive social atmosphere
upgrades.note: cultivate 搭配 atmosphere 更书面高级，避免口语化的 make + good
